steps: Peel and dice sweet potato into 2 cm cubes; boil in a medium saucepan for 12 minutes, until very tender.
Drain sweet potato and mash with coconut milk in a large bowl until smooth.
Mince garlic and add to the bowl with cumin and turmeric; stir to combine.
Pulse chicken in a food processor until finely ground, then add to the bowl.
Add oat flour and egg; mix until a soft, uniform dough forms.
Shape dough into 16 patties, each about 1.5 cm thick and 5 cm wide.
Heat canola oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Cook patties in batches for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through with no pink inside.
Serve warm; refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
